identity: Gor Drazhak musters the Throng; round its walls scorpions, hyenas and a bandit ration-broker take their cut.

quests.title: A Sentry Needs Both Feet
quests.text: Gor Drazhak's sentries should be watching for enemy banners, yet half their night goes to watching their ankles. Kill eight Dust-Stinger Scorpions after dark on the {name:steppe}, {dir_of:gor_drazhak:steppe}. The Throng needs its guards standing firm.

quests.title: Optional: The Last Laugh Costs Extra
quests.text: Kill eight Dustpack Hyenas by day in the {name:badlands}, {dir_of:gor_drazhak:badlands}, and keep our supply carts moving. They follow the rations as though we packed lunch for them; if they want a meal from the Throng, they can learn to carry a spear.

quests.title: His Profit, Our Empty Bowls
quests.text: Bandit Ration-Broker Garr buys Korr's stolen supplies and charges hungry fighters for the privilege of getting them back. At the {name:tollcamp}, {dir_of:gor_drazhak:tollcamp}, kill six Toll Bandit Archers and Garr himself. The hands that fill our war bands' bowls deserve better than this.

quests.title: Your Place in the Line
quests.text: You have seen what it takes to keep the Throng fed and marching. Now report to Drek Rampbinder at Red Ramp Post on Bannerbreak Mesa, where our fighters hold the line. Stand with them as you stood for the people behind these walls.

quests.title: Bounty: A Toll Paid in Arrows
quests.text: More Toll Bandit Archers have settled into the {name:tollcamp}; evidently word travels slower than greed. Kill six and return for your bounty. You may take the job again twenty minutes after collecting your pay.

quests.title: The Ladle Commands
quests.text: Warriors can argue about who leads the march; at supper, every last one answers to my ladle. Bring me eight pieces of Raw Meat and two Braided Sinew from the Waterhole Zebras on the {name:steppe}. We have ration bundles to tie and a hungry muster to fill them for.

quests.title: Spears Out, Word Back
quests.text: Speargrass Wellhold keeps sending us spears. Brakka Jarward wants word back, and you look ready for a walk. Travel to the Wellhold in Speargrass Reach and speak to Brakka for me. If Brakka asks about my stew, say the bowls come back empty.

quests.title: Salt Keeps a Friendship
quests.text: Our troll allies send fish from Whisperreed Landing, and our salt makes the return journey. Go to Whispering Reedlands and speak to Taleko Drycord at the landing. Give our allies a hand; a shared cooking pot holds the Throng together as surely as any war banner.
